blocks.header:
Tool Heat Shrink Technology

Less Energy, Maximum Profit
blocks.body:
With »redomatic« from ZOLLER, you save time, reduce your electricity costs, and extend the life of your shrink fit holders thanks to the perfect interplay of electronics, software, and mechanics, combined with a well-designed, safe shrink process.

30% energy savings

blocks.title: 30% energy savings
blocks.text:
ZOLLER induction technology allows you to heat your shrink fit holders optimally. For you, this means: consistent heating across the entire clamping range and only for as long as necessary. This results in short heating and cooling times, short cycle times, reduces wear on the holders, and extends their lifetime.

A particular advantage of »redomatic«—through which ZOLLER contributes to sustainable manufacturing practices—is the energy savings of up to 30% compared to the previous model. We’re especially proud of this. The heat and energy are delivered exactly where you need them to safely shrink and unshrink your tools.

blocks.header:
Tool Heat Shrink Technology

Smart Design for Maximum Efficiency
blocks.body:
A smart, well-designed highlight of »the« »powerShrink« is the ZOLLER induction coil. Two windings connected in parallel within the coil can be activated separately and controlled differently depending on the clamping diameter and length. This enables optimal energy transfer to the clamping area, accelerates the heating and cooling process, and protects your tool holders.

Induction coil with »varOct« shielding system Stand-alone »powerShrink« solution

blocks.title: When Art Hits the Mark
blocks.text:
Inspired by modern architecture and optical kinematics, ZOLLER’s Research and Development department has created a masterpiece. The ZOLLER induction coil with the »varOct« shielding system ensures maximum efficiency and ergonomics in the shrink-wrapping process.

8 ferrite elements

Ingeniously conceived. Perfectly constructed. The eight variable elements of the »varOct« coil shielding glide smoothly past one another—a design masterpiece. ZOLLER’s unique approach delivers unbeatable design and efficiency.

blocks.title: A Top-of-the-Line Stand-Alone Solution
blocks.text:
Shrink and unshrink tools in record time while saving energy and protecting the chuck: You get all these benefits with the »powerShrink« inductive shrink system.

Learn more

spots.label: flue gas suction device
spots.text:
flue gas suction device

flue gas suction device

Reliably removes flue gases from the operator’s work area. The established and patented flue gas suction device above the induction coil has been expanded to include an integrated suction system inside the coil housing. The flue gases are thus suctioned directly where they are generated.

spots.label: Induction coil »»varOct««
spots.text:
Induction coil »»varOct««

Smart Induction Coil with »»varOct«« shielding system

With automatic diameter adjustment for shaft diameters up to 32 mm for optimal heating performance in every case. The heating process is continuously monitored. The inner diameter of the »»varOct«« shielding system can be quickly and automatedly adjusted to the required diameter using a detent mechanism. Thanks to the maximum inner diameter of 45.8 mm, even tools with larger cutting edges can be simply unshrinked.

Also available as an optional feature with a quick-change interface for rapid coil changes from 14 kVA to 22 kVA.

spots.label: »»eQ«« One-Hand Control Handle
spots.text:
»»eQ«« One-Hand Control Handle

»»eQ«« (ergonomic & quick) One-Hand Control Knob

With just one hand, you can quickly move the optic carrier simultaneously along the Z and X axes and effortlessly position it exactly where you need it. Additionally, other functions from »pilot 4.0« can be integrated into the »»eQ«’s« auxiliary button.

spots.label: »»asza«« length setting system
spots.text:
»»asza«« length setting system

»»asza«« Automatic Length Limit System

Accurate to within 10 μm along the Z-axis for shrinking.

Shrink length monitoring—for safe and controlled shrinking of tools with monitoring of the minimum shrink length.

spots.label: »»ace«« high-precision spindle
spots.text:
»»ace«« high-precision spindle

High-Precision »Spindle »ace««

High-precision, universal spindle system with clamping characteristics similar to those of a machine spindle, guaranteeing μm-accurate holding and clamping of tools. The universal adapter tool post changing system allows adaptation to virtually any tool holder system.

spots.label: Cooling Bells
spots.text:
Cooling Bells

Innovative cooling bells with »»coolbyLight«« user guidance

For a safe and simple cooling process thanks to the LED color system. Alternatively, the »redomatic 600« can be selected in an execution with standard cooling bells.

Energy manager software for the cooling unit—the cooling unit is automatically activated only when needed.

spots.label: carrier system
spots.text:
carrier system

carrier system

For holding the heat-shrinking electronics, cooling bells, mounting rings, limit rods, and the ZOLLER »»masterPiece«« setting adapter. The display of the »»sls«« shrink-fit guidance system in the image processing software ensures quick selection of the required accessories.

The »»sls«« heat-shrink guiding system – »pilot 4.0« – guides the operator safely and quickly through the shrink-fit process using exact steps in the software.

spots.label: »»pilot«« image processing technology »4.0«
spots.text:
»»pilot«« image processing technology »4.0«

IPC with »pilot 4.0« image processing software

The control system, consisting of an IPC, »pilot 4.0«, and a 24-inch TFT color monitor, handles all processing tasks—including adjusting, measuring, and shrinking—and ensures safe and simple operation. The monitor is adjustable in height and inclination, making the software as user-friendly as possible. The »»cockpit«« provides space for a keyboard and mouse, as well as storage for label and laser printers, a scanner, and tools such as Allen keys.
